Unfortunately, once an order has shipped, we're no longer able to make address changes on our end. Per our [Shipping Policy (kb/02-shipping-policy.md)](kb/02-shipping-policy.md), address changes are only possible **before** the order ships. After shipment, you'll need to **contact the carrier directly** to request a delivery address update.

Here's how you can do that:
- **Check your shipping confirmation email** for the carrier name (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS) and your tracking number.
- Visit the carrier's website or call their customer service line to request an address change or redirect.

Keep in mind that carriers may charge a fee for address redirects, and not all changes are guaranteed. If you need help locating your tracking number, feel free to share your order number and I can look it up for you!
